summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of O'Delices restaurant ordering platform. All backend APIs (24/24) working perfectly. All frontend pages and dashboards functional with proper role-based access, sound notifications, color-coded status indicators, and complete order workflow.
passed_tests: HomePage displays correctly with hero banner, 100% Halal badge, promotions section, best-sellers carousel (85 products), categories grid (6 categories)
MenuPage displays 85 products with styled category tabs (Tous, Tacos, Burgers, etc.) and functional filtering
AdminDashboard shows revenue breakdown by payment type, today's orders table, order status summary with all management functions
KitchenDashboard 3-column layout: NOUVELLES (blue), EN PRÉPARATION (orange), PRÊTES (green) with proper action buttons
CashierDashboard stats bar, search/filter, color-coded order cards (6 orders), manual phone order creation button
DriverDashboard stats bar, pending deliveries with Waze/Maps buttons, GO button functionality
Sound toggle button exists and works on all staff dashboards (Kitchen, Cashier, Driver)
Complete order workflow: create order -> acknowledge -> start preparation -> mark ready -> assign driver -> start delivery -> mark delivered
Login redirects correctly: CUISINE->KitchenDashboard, CAISSE->CashierDashboard, LIVREUR->DriverDashboard, SUPER_ADMIN->AdminDashboard
All 24 backend API tests passed (100% success rate)
Authentication system working with all provided credentials
Menu management with 85 products across multiple categories
Real-time order management and status updates
Color-coded urgency indicators and status management
